authorityFlow: Factory catalog -> current Planning dependency intent -> current TaskGraph/task capability -> validated package.json -> controlled npm lockfile materialization -> direct-root lockfile validation -> npm ci/build/tests/audit gates.
plannerIntegration: Planner receives a bounded derived catalog context and accepted planning is blocked when DependencyPlan or architecture dependency names are not catalog-approved.
implementationIntegration: Implementation receives baseline plus parsed current plan intent; it cannot add an optional package without catalog, plan, and task-capability approval. Stale accepted planning is rejected before proposal work.
changeProposalIntegration: package.json operations are authority-validated before atomic apply; package-lock.json operations are forbidden for AI ChangeProposals; rejected proposals do not mutate the workspace.
runtimeCommandIntegration: Only fixed npm command specs remain: package-lock materialization uses npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund with no package arguments, and npm ci consumes an already authorized/current lockfile.
shadcnIntegration: Registry metadata remains read-only. Direct component dependencies must be in the authority-derived allowed task set; unknown metadata dependencies fail normalization and never modify package.json.
manifestValidation: All direct dependencies and devDependencies require exact catalog name, exact catalog spec, correct section, no duplicates, npm-only manager, and all baseline entries.
lockfileOwnership: package-lock.json is npm/materializer-owned, not AI-authored. Its npm v3 root direct dependency and devDependency declarations must exactly match package.json.
transitiveDependencyPolicy: Transitive packages are selected by npm under authorized direct dependencies and do not require direct catalog entries; lockfile integrity, build/tests, and npm audit remain required.
npmOnlyPolicy: pnpm, yarn, bun, and non-npm packageManager declarations are denied.
projectCurrentnessBehavior: Implementation input validates project/version identity and accepted Planning checksum (document checksum or acceptance checksum); the authority context carries project/version/planning identity into manifest/runtime checks.
taskCapabilityBehavior: Optional entries, when explicitly cataloged in a future maintenance change, require current plan intent and allowed task capability. The current repository has zero owned optional direct version specs, so undocumented optional candidates fail closed as PACKAGE_NOT_APPROVED.
